name: production-intelligence
description: Post-deployment observability and incident discipline: environments, bounded production snapshots, release verification, logs, incidents and deployment correlation.
guidelines: Do not treat HTTP 200 immediately after deploy as sufficient release verification.
Collect production evidence from application/container health, public probe latency, Docker resource snapshots and scoped Nginx request/error samples.
Correlate incidents with environment, deployment, commit and release timing before blaming a code change.
Only use Nginx 5xx thresholds for site-scoped logs; global fallback logs are evidence but not safe attribution.
Keep development, staging and production state distinct and compare verified source/target releases before promotion.
Open or update durable incidents for concrete operational failures and resolve them only after recovery evidence is collected.
definition_of_done: environment and deployment mapping is known
open P0/P1 incidents are surfaced in readiness
logs and metrics remain bounded and searchable
post-deployment health evidence is associated with the release commit
